projects.title: Orebound
projects.kind: Game · one HTML file · no dependencies
projects.blurb: Dig through a vast pixel world looking for the one golden pixel. Shoot balls into rock, they bounce, and every pixel you break pays for the next shot.
projects.alt: Orebound: a cavern dug out of dark rock, with orange balls scattered through it and a ball-type dock along the bottom.

projects.title: Dumb Clanker
projects.blurb: A programming game. Every bot in the arena is mechanically identical, so the only thing that makes yours better is the program you wrote for it.
projects.alt: The Dumb Clanker workshop: a block palette on the left and a Clank Script program built from colored blocks in the center.

projects.title: Plot Twist: World Deed
projects.blurb: A land grab on one shared Earth. Claim 300 meter tiles anywhere on the planet, build on them, and hold them against everyone else playing.
projects.alt: The Plot Twist: World Deed title screen over a dark world map.

projects.title: Ember Line
projects.blurb: Wildfire containment on real terrain. Cut line, drop water and defend structures for one 90 minute operational period while the wind shifts underneath you.
projects.alt: Ember Line: a fire burning on a real basemap, with a cell inspector panel showing fuel type and dispatch options.

projects.title: Roadworks
projects.blurb: A shared, real-time game about keeping the roads open. A new work board appears every morning and the whole office dispatches crews to the same one.
projects.alt: The Roadworks dispatch board: a map of West Virginia covered in colored work orders, with a queue panel on the right.

projects.title: Orrery
projects.blurb: A project tracker drawn as a personal galaxy. Every project is a planet, every finished task is a piece of it, and everything still open orbits as dust.
projects.alt: Orrery: named planets of different sizes arranged around a central light in a dark starfield.

projects.title: Gielinor Deeds
projects.blurb: Own the ground you stand on. A single-player land game over the real Old School RuneScape map, where 29,766 ownable parcels were each classified and priced from the game's own cache.
projects.alt: Gielinor Deeds: an Old School RuneScape scene with a parcel outlined on the ground, and the plugin's Estate panel showing balance, income and the deed underfoot.
